newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech IPB Bank gets $150mln synd loan.
newsitem.headline: Czech IPB Bank gets $150mln synd loan.

text.p: Czech bank IPB a.s. said on Friday it had signed a $150 million syndicated five-year loan arranged by Barclays Bank, Bayerische Landesbank, Fuji Bank and Union Bank of Switzerland.
The loan was priced at 30 basis points above LIBOR, IPB said in a statement.

"As the fourth big foreign loan for IPB, it will be used for quality investment and business projects of domestic clients of the bank and for their pre-export and export financing," IPB said in a statement.
The statement added that eight renowned foreign banks had participated in offering the loan and that others would follow. It did not list the participants.
